A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at [Location], they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
